exact_statement: Prior conclusions of A017-FOUR-EDGE-COMPATIBILITY@3 remain at their stated scopes. For arbitrary Boolean b,c on disjoint original physical supports, selected i in b, p=Inf_i(b),e=I(D_i b), Delta_i(bc)=Delta_i(b),B_i(bc)=B_i(b),Inf_i(bc)=p and I(D_i(bc))=e+p I(c). For the SAME fresh shared gate A_h=1 on p0=0 and (-1)^z h on p0=1, Delta_i(A_(bc))=Delta_i(b)/2, B_i(A_(bc))=B_i(b)/2,Inf_i(A_(bc))=p/2, 2I(D_i(A_(bc)))=e+p I(c)+3p/2. The saved six-bit b has p=1/8,e=5/16,H=21/4,I=9/4,B_i>4p, but delta=Delta_i(b)=-11/4+(25/32)log2(5)+(9/8)log2(3)<(4+2/ln(2))/8. For every t>=1 and every adaptive stopped prefix querying each prescribed selected factor bit at most once in A_(b^tensor(t)), actual entropy debit equals delta*E N/2 and queried original influence equals E N/16, so the SAME K pays all prefixes with both full terminals retained. Every complete adaptive permutation has bad-filtered raw boundary bill (35t^2+29t)/128, versus original influence 1+9t/8; the spectator-subtracted bill is t/2. The raw-bill ratio diverges, not H/I. Disjoint support is essential: b=(-1)^(i*x),c=(-1)^x gives Delta_i(bc)=2, I(D_i(bc))=1/4,p=1/2,I(c)=1, refuting unconditional subtraction under overlap.
hypotheses: Uniform physical cube, Boolean signs, entropy in bits; real derivative influence is full Fourier energy.
Spectator cancellation requires actual disjoint physical supports, not inferred spectral independence.
Shared gate p0,z remains fresh/unqueried throughout core-only histories and its physical influence is kept once.
Adaptive permutation observes previously queried selected bits only; stopped-prefix theorem retains every full terminal.
No claim that all adaptive policies fail, that H/I diverges, or that arbitrary overlapping residual cores are paid.
